name: Houston Fabric User Group
reason: Houston's Microsoft Fabric / Power BI user group (838 members), which keeps meeting in person. It ran 'Global Fabric Day 2026 - Houston' (Houston Fabric Day) on Sat Jun 13 2026 at the Microsoft Technology Center, 750 Town and Country Blvd, a full-day community conference with a keynote by Patrick LeBlanc. Its Meetup page also lists past events on Sep 12 2026, Jan 24 2026 and Dec 8 2025. Following the group picks up the next Fabric Day when it is posted.
